about: The Workbench icons of the FreeDink drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's own icon (share/pixmaps/freedink.png, GPL 3 or later), made smaller. FreeDink-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, FreeDink.info beside the program. ReadMe.info is also copied for upstream's README and the licence; Folder.info for dink and doc.
